PYTHON.name: NoCircularDependenciesPolicy
PYTHON.description: Reject Python projects that contain circular dependencies.

PYTHON.name: FunctionComplexityPolicy
PYTHON.description: Reject Python functions whose reported complexity exceeds the threshold.

PYTHON.name: TODOCommentPolicy
PYTHON.description: Reject Python code that still contains TODO or FIXME markers.

PYTHON.name: RequireDocstringPolicy
PYTHON.description: Reject Python public APIs that are missing docstrings.

JAVA.name: JavaLayeringPolicy
JAVA.description: Reject Java service classes that import controller classes.

JAVA.name: PublicFieldPolicy
JAVA.description: Reject Java classes that expose mutable public fields.

JAVA.name: MissingJavadocPolicy
JAVA.description: Reject Java public types that are missing Javadoc.

JAVA.name: JavaNamingConventionPolicy
JAVA.description: Reject Java code that violates naming conventions.

JAVA.name: JavaDTOImportPolicy
JAVA.description: Reject Java controller classes that import DTO classes directly.

JAVA.name: JavaSpringFrameworkImportPolicy
JAVA.description: Reject Java classes that import Spring Framework classes outside of the main application class.

JAVA.name: JavaModelImportPolicy
JAVA.description: Reject Java controller classes that import model classes directly.

JAVA.name: JavaApplicationClassImportPolicy
JAVA.description: Reject Java application classes that import controller, DTO, or model classes directly.

JAVA.name: JavaControllerFrameworkImportPolicy
JAVA.description: Reject Java controller classes that import framework-specific response status classes directly.

JAVA.name: JavaControllerServiceImportPolicy
JAVA.description: Reject Java controller classes that import service classes directly, bypassing the established layering.

TYPESCRIPT.name: StrictTypingPolicy
TYPESCRIPT.description: Reject TypeScript code that uses the any type.

TYPESCRIPT.name: NoUnsafeTypeAssertionPolicy
TYPESCRIPT.description: Reject TypeScript code that uses unsafe as any assertions.

TYPESCRIPT.name: NoConsoleLogPolicy
TYPESCRIPT.description: Reject TypeScript code that still contains console logging.

TYPESCRIPT.name: NoExplicitAnyInAPIEndpointsPolicy
TYPESCRIPT.description: Reject TypeScript code that uses the 'any' type in API endpoint files.

TYPESCRIPT.name: NoConsoleLogInAPIEndpointsPolicy
TYPESCRIPT.description: Reject TypeScript code that contains console logging in API endpoint files.

TYPESCRIPT.name: NoExplicitAnyInUtilsPolicy
TYPESCRIPT.description: Reject TypeScript code that uses the 'any' type in utility files.
